coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep of information visualization design methodology covering: (1) Foundational frameworks: Munzner nested model, Shneiderman information-seeking mantra, Cleveland-McGill graphical perception hierarchy; (2) Seminal authors: Munzner, Shneiderman, Cleveland & McGill, Mackinlay, Tukey, Tufte, Norman, Ware, Card; (3) Methodological works: design study methodology, task taxonomies, visualization literacy assessment; (4) Theoretical foundations: visual encoding effectiveness, perceptual principles, preattentive processing, gestalt principles, sensemaking, semiotic approaches; (5) Practical guidance: design guidelines, interaction techniques, color design, chart effectiveness; (6) Recent advances: surveys, recommendation systems, accessibility. Sources span peer-reviewed venues (CHI, UIST, TOCHI, IEEE TVCG, IEEE InfoVis), seminal books, and canonical papers. Deduplication applied across multiple searches. Coverage includes T0 meta-analyses, T1 peer-reviewed works, T2 textbooks/seminal authors, and T3 high-quality practitioner resources. Notable gaps: deep coverage of 3D/immersive vis deferred to separate leaves; machine learning in vis deferred; domain-specific applications deferred to domain leaves.

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Comprehensive 15-chapter textbook (2014) covering visualization fundamentals, data/task abstraction, four-level validation model, visual encoding (marks and channels), interaction, and case studies. Canonical reference for infovis design.

sources.title: A Nested Model for Visualization Design and Validation
sources.notes: Foundational paper introducing the four-level nested model for characterizing and validating visualization design: problem domain, data/task abstraction, visual encoding/interaction, and algorithms.

sources.title: The Visual Information-Seeking Mantra
sources.notes: Seminal framework: 'Overview first, zoom and filter, then details-on-demand.' Principle for designing interactive visualization systems for exploratory data analysis.

sources.title: Graphical Perception: Theory, Experimentation, and Application to the Development of Graphical Methods
sources.notes: Seminal empirical study ranking 10 elementary perceptual tasks by accuracy: position (common scale), position (non-aligned), length, direction, angle, area, volume, curvature, shading, color saturation. Foundational for encoding effectiveness.

sources.title: Automating the Design of Graphical Presentations of Relational Information
sources.notes: Pioneering work (1986) on automatic visualization design using expressiveness and effectiveness criteria for graphical languages. Introduced composition algebra for generating design alternatives.

sources.title: Readings in Information Visualization: Using Vision to Think
sources.notes: Seminal anthology (1999) edited by Card, Mackinlay, Shneiderman collecting 47 classic papers establishing visualization as a discipline. Covers foundational concepts and early applications.

sources.title: Low-Level Components of Analytic Activity in Information Visualization
sources.notes: Task taxonomy (2005) defining 10 low-level analytic tasks (e.g., locate, filter, compute derived values) as a checklist for visualization system design and evaluation.

sources.title: Design Study Methodology: Reflections from the Trenches and the Stacks
sources.notes: Methodological framework (2012) for conducting design studies in visualization research. Proposes 9-stage process (learn, winnow, cast, discover, design, implement, deploy, reflect, write) with guidance and pitfalls.

sources.title: A Multi-Level Typology of Abstract Visualization Tasks
sources.notes: Task taxonomy (2013) organizing visualization tasks across three dimensions: why (present, discover, enjoy, produce), how, and task I/O. Bridges domain-specific and domain-agnostic task descriptions.

sources.title: Information Visualization: Perception for Design
sources.notes: Comprehensive textbook by Colin Ware on perceptual principles underlying effective visualization design. Covers visual attention, preattentive processing, gestalt principles, color perception, 3D perception.

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
sources.notes: Seminal book (1983) on visual encoding, data-ink ratio, and graphical integrity. Foundational design principles for statistical graphics and information display.

sources.title: Envisioning Information
sources.notes: Companion to Visual Display covering maps, charts, scientific presentations, diagrams, layering and separation, color and information, and small multiples.

sources.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
sources.notes: Foundational work (1977) introducing exploratory data analysis paradigm and visualization tools (boxplots, stem-and-leaf, five-number summary). Contrasts with confirmatory hypothesis testing.

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things
sources.notes: Cognitive science and user-centered design principles (affordances, signifiers, constraints, mapping). Applicable to visualization interface design and mental models.

sources.title: Semiologie Graphique (Semiology of Graphics)
sources.notes: Foundational semiotic framework (1967/1983) identifying visual variables (position, size, shape, orientation, color hue, color value, texture) for mapping data to visual form.

sources.title: VLAT: Development of a Visualization Literacy Assessment Test
sources.notes: Standardized assessment tool (2016) with 53 items covering 12 visualization types. Quantifies visualization literacy as ability to extract, interpret, and apply data in graphics.

sources.title: Mini-VLAT: A Short and Effective Measure of Visualization Literacy
sources.notes: Condensed 12-item assessment variant of VLAT (2023) for rapid evaluation of visualization literacy. High correlation with full VLAT.

sources.title: Harnessing Preattentive Processes for Multivariate Data Visualization
sources.notes: Research on preattentive visual features (<500ms, <200ms eye movement latency): color, orientation, size, shape, curvature, line length. Principles for rapid visual tasks.

sources.title: Toward a Deeper Understanding of the Role of Interaction in Information Visualization
sources.notes: Framework for understanding interaction in visualization: navigation, selection, filtering, reconfiguration. Task-specific interaction design for exploratory analysis.

sources.title: The Sensemaking Process in Intelligence Analysis
sources.notes: Model of sensemaking with two loops (foraging and synthesis) for complex data exploration. Describes cognitive processes of hypothesis formation and evidence gathering.

sources.title: Gestalt Principles of Visual Perception
sources.notes: Foundational perceptual psychology principles (proximity, similarity, closure, continuation, figure-ground, symmetry) applied to visualization design for visual grouping and organization.

sources.title: Colorblind Accessibility in Data Visualization
sources.notes: Accessibility design for 8% of males with color vision deficiency. Guidelines: avoid red-green, use patterns/textures, high contrast, WCAG 1.4.1 compliance.

sources.title: Scientific Colour Maps
sources.notes: Perceptually uniform, colorblind-friendly, and accurate color palettes for scientific visualization. Addresses artifacts in rainbow colormaps and uniformity in HCL space.

sources.title: Treemaps: Space-Filling Visualization of Hierarchical Data
sources.notes: Hierarchical visualization technique (1991, Johnson & Shneiderman) using rectangular space-filling approach. Area proportional to quantitative attribute.

sources.title: Dynamic Queries for Information Exploration
sources.notes: Interaction technique for real-time filtering via sliders and buttons. Updates database query results within 100ms. Foundation for direct manipulation query interfaces.

sources.title: A Design Study Process Model for Medical Visualization
sources.notes: Contemporary application of design study methodology to domain-specific visualization (medical). Demonstrates iterative refinement and validation with domain experts.

sources.title: Understanding the Research-Practice Gap in Visualization Design Guidelines
sources.notes: Examines disconnect between academic guidelines and practitioner adoption. Identifies factors in guideline effectiveness and communication.

sources.title: Automatic Synthesis of Visualization Design Knowledge Bases
sources.notes: Data-driven methods to synthesize design knowledge bases from visualization corpora. Enables automated reasoning and interpretable recommendations.

sources.title: Data Visualization State of the Industry 2024 Report
sources.notes: Industry survey tracking tool adoption and practitioner methodologies. Six-year longitudinal study of visualization practice trends.

sources.title: A Survey on Information Visualization: Recent Advances and Challenges
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey covering InfoVis advances, application domains, and research challenges. Meta-analysis of the field's state.

sources.title: Survey of Surveys: Mapping the Landscape of Survey Papers in Information Visualization
sources.notes: Meta-analysis of survey papers in visualization, categorizing coverage areas and identifying gaps. Provides landscape of survey literature.

sources.title: On Sense Making and the Generation of Knowledge in Visual Analytics
sources.notes: Theoretical framework connecting sensemaking processes, exploratory data analysis, and knowledge generation in visual analytics systems.

sources.title: Information Visualization and Semiotic Morphisms
sources.notes: Formal semiotic framework for visualization: sign systems, representational morphisms, preservation of structure. Theoretical foundation for visualization design.

sources.title: Information Visualization Evaluation Using Crowdsourcing
sources.notes: Methodology for large-scale empirical evaluation of visualization designs using crowdsourced user studies. Addresses scalability of evaluation.

sources.title: A Survey of Perception-Based Visualization Studies by Task
sources.notes: Systematic review of empirical perception studies evaluating visualization encodings. Organized by task type (comparison, estimation, etc.).

sources.title: Characterizing Data Visualization Literacy: A Systematic Literature Review
sources.notes: Comprehensive review of visualization literacy definitions, assessment tools, and barriers. Meta-analysis identifying conceptual frameworks.

sources.title: Intents, Techniques, and Components: A Unified Analysis of Interaction Authoring Tasks in Data Visualization
sources.notes: Framework for interaction design in visualization: intents (zoom, filter, select), techniques, and components. Unifies interaction taxonomy.

sources.title: From Perception to Decision: Assessing the Role of Chart Types Affordances in High-Level Decision Tasks
sources.notes: Empirical study of how chart type affordances support decision-making tasks. Links perceptual properties to task performance.

sources.title: Designing Annotations in Visualization: Considerations from Visualization Practitioners and Educators
sources.notes: Survey on annotation design in visualization. Bridges practitioner practice and pedagogical goals. (2025)

sources.title: Tasks Taxonomy for Graphs (InfoVis Wiki)
sources.notes: Community-curated reference on task taxonomies for graph visualization. Aggregates multiple task classification schemes.

sources.title: Visualization.info Educational Resource Hub
sources.notes: Collection of educational resources: lecture videos, tutorials, textbooks, course materials on data visualization.

sources.title: Are Pie Charts Evil? An Assessment of Pie and Donut Charts Compared to Bar Charts
sources.notes: Empirical evaluation of chart effectiveness. Position (bar) superior for magnitude comparison; angle (pie) effective for part-to-whole.

sources.title: Preattentive Processing and How to Use It in Design
sources.notes: Practical guide to applying preattentive visual properties in design. Covers four basic properties: color, form, movement, spatial position.

sources.title: Preattentive Processing (InfoVis Wiki)
sources.notes: Reference on preattentive visual features and mechanisms. Foundational concept for rapid visual perception in visualization.

sources.title: A Complete Guide to Ethnography in User Research
sources.notes: Methodological guide for ethnographic studies in visualization research. Participant-centered approaches for understanding visualization usage.
